name: Clopas/Cleopas
title: The Disciple on the Road to Emmaus
summary: Clopas (also known as Cleopas) was one of Jesus' disciples who met the risen Jesus on the road to Emmaus. He was likely married to Mary, one of the women at the cross, and may have been the brother of Joseph, Jesus' foster father. His encounter with Jesus on resurrection day is one of the most touching accounts in the Gospels.

keyEvents.title: On the Road to Emmaus
keyEvents.description: Cleopas and another disciple were walking to the village of Emmaus on resurrection day, deeply saddened by Jesus' death. The risen Jesus joined them, but they did not recognize him.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Explains the Scriptures
keyEvents.description: As they walked together, Jesus explained all the prophecies about the Messiah from Moses and the prophets, and their hearts burned within them.

keyEvents.title: Recognition at the Breaking of Bread
keyEvents.description: When Jesus broke bread at the meal, their eyes were opened and they recognized him. At that same moment, he became invisible to them.

keyEvents.title: The Testimony to the Eleven
keyEvents.description: Cleopas and his companion hurried back to Jerusalem that same evening to tell the eleven apostles that they had seen the risen Lord.

keyEvents.title: Mary at the cross
keyEvents.description: The wife of Clopas, Mary, was one of the women who stood by Jesus' cross along with Jesus' mother and Mary Magdalene.
